keySentence: Her kindness slowly changed everyone around her.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna shared kindness every day. Slowly, the people around her felt happier. Aunt Polly began to smile. The neighbors became friendly. Her kindness slowly changed everyone around her.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna did not try to change anyone. She simply shared her joy and kindness every day. But people could not help but feel different around her. The strict aunt began to soften. The angry neighbors started to wave. Her kindness slowly changed everyone around her, one heart at a time.
facts.Word cards: changed = 변화시켰다 / positivity = 긍정 / contagious = 전염되는 / spread = 퍼졌다
